title: docs(objectql): RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES 的 summary 排除理由改为与实现相符 (#6014)
body:
Fixes objectstack-ai/objectstack#6014

纯注释订正,**零行为变化**:未触及 `RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES` 集合本身,未触及任何一行代码。

## 前提复核(在 `origin/main` 重验,单据是 lead 不是 spec)

单据前提**成立**,四条逐条实读:

| 前提 | 结论 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|
| 误述句逐字仍在 | ✅ | `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts:568-571`(改前),原文 "Deliberately NOT `formula` / `summary`: those are computed on read from a plan, never stored from the write payload, so there is no caller value to strip." |
| summary 是物理存储列 | ✅ | `engine.ts` `recomputeSummaries()` 用 `await this.update(desc.parentObject, { id: parentId, [desc.summaryField]: value }, ...)` 写入 |
| #6013 已落,insert 也写初值 | ✅ | commit `d56bcdb45` 在 main;`initializeSummaryFields`(`engine.ts:4329`)在 insert 路径 `:5162` / `:5167` 调用 |
| formula 那半句是对的 | ✅ | `applyFormulaPlan`(`engine.ts:570`)只按 `FormulaPlanEntry[]` 求值,summary **不在** plan 里 —— 所以 formula/summary 并列才是错的 |

补充一条单据没写、但让危险方向更具体的实测:**strip 站点跑在 seed 之后**。`initializeSummaryFields` 在 `:5162`,`stripRuntimeOwnedFields` 在 `:5276`,而 `suppliedPerRow`(`:5248`)是 **原始 caller payload**。所以若把 summary 加进集合,caller 送 `task_count: 42` 时:42 被 strip 掉,0 也补不上(seed 正因为 caller 供了值而 `continue`),列落回 `null` —— 恰是 #6013 要消灭的状态,且写入仍报成功。

## 新旧措辞对照

**旧**(4 行,一段):

> Deliberately NOT `formula` / `summary`: those are computed on read from a plan, never stored from the write payload, so there is no caller value to strip. Keep this set to types whose value is (a) persisted and (b) issued by the runtime.

**新**(拆成四段,要点):

1. **formula 单独一段** —— 保留原判断,补上出处 `applyFormulaPlan`;
2. **summary 单独一段** —— 写明它 **NOT computed on read**,是 runtime 维护的**存储列**(`recomputeSummaries` 写入 + #5749 / PR #6013 的 insert seed),读路径直读该列,所以 `["task_count","=",0]` 是库内比对、never-seeded 的 `null` 才会静默漏行;并明确点出 **summary 同时满足 (a) persisted 和 (b) runtime-issued 却仍被排除** —— 即旧判据根本判不出它;
3. **真实判据一段** —— 第三条 `(c) 没有合法的 caller 供值`:autonumber 满足(伪造业务标识、无人纠正),summary 不满足(派生缓存、下次子表写入自愈,且显式写初值是 #6013 明确支持的路径);
4. **反向警告一段** —— `DO NOT "fix the code to match this comment"`,连同上面那条 seed/strip 顺序的后果;
5. 收尾判据从 (a)(b) 两条补成 **(a)(b)(c) 三条**。

## 验证(如实)

这是注释级变更,**没有反向验证肢可做** —— 删掉/还原注释不会让任何测试变色,任何"反向验证"输出都只能是编造,故不提供。实际证据是"零行为变化"+"文本已换":

```
$ pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck
> tsc --noEmit                      -- 退出码 0,无输出

$ pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test -- --maxWorkers=2
 Test Files  131 passed (131)
      Tests  2168 passed (2168)
   Duration  87.77s

$ node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs
check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 5857 tracked text file(s); ... no raw ASCII control bytes)
```

diff 面自证只动注释:

```
$ git diff --stat
 packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts | 42 +++++++++++++++++++---
 1 file changed, 38 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

$ git diff -U0 | grep -E '^[+-]' | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)' | grep -vE '^[+-] \* ' | grep -vE '^[+-]\s*$'
+ *

$ git diff origin/main -- packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts | grep -E "^[+-].*new Set\("
(no diff line touches the Set literal -- collection unchanged)
```

grep 证明旧误述已不在、新措辞在:

```
$ grep -n 'formula` / `summary' packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts
(no match -- the joint formula/summary misstatement is gone)

$ grep -n "NOT computed on read\|COMPLETELY DIFFERENT reason\|never legitimately supplied" packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts
572: * Deliberately NOT `summary` either — but for a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT reason,
574: * `summary` is NOT computed on read: it is a real stored column the runtime
605: * runtime, and (c) never legitimately supplied by a caller.

$ grep -n "RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES: ReadonlySet" packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts
607:const RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES: ReadonlySet(string) = new Set(['autonumber']);   -- 集合原样
```

## 必答项

**1. #6013 已落 —— 新措辞是否把「insert 也写初值」算进去了?**

**是。** 新注释原文:"`ObjectQL.recomputeSummaries` writes it with an ordinary `update(parent, { [summaryField]: value })` after any child write, **and since #5749 / PR #6013 `initializeSummaryFields` also seeds it at parent INSERT**." 且第三段进一步用它作论据(显式写初值是**受支持**的授权路径,`initializeSummaryFields` 特意保留 caller 供的值),第四段用 seed 与 strip 的**先后顺序**推出具体回归后果。#6013 = `d56bcdb45`,已在 main。

**2. record-validator.ts 核对结论 —— 含不含同一误解?**

**不含,原文成立,未改。** `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts:550-551` 原文:

```
// Remaining types (formula/summary/autonumber outputs, json/code payloads)
// are explicitly open per the spec contract — see field-value.zod.ts.
```

它讲的是 **ADR-0104 的 value-shape 开放性**(哪些值类别没有严格形状门禁),不是持久化/写路径归属 —— 整段上下文是 `valueShapeStrictEffective` / `mediaStrictEffective` 的 warn-first 判定。它对 summary **没有**任何 "computed on read" 或 "never stored" 的主张。反向佐证:它把 summary 与 **autonumber outputs 并列**,而 autonumber 恰恰是 persisted + runtime-owned 的那一个 —— 这个分组与"summary 是存储列"是**一致**的,而非矛盾。故不动。

**3. #5503 / preserveAudit —— 写下的理由与实现是否逐字相符?**

**逐字相符**,四处代码位置(行号为本 PR 落地后):

- 只针对 caller-supplied:`rule-validator.ts:750` `if (!suppliedKeys.has(name)) continue; // hook/middleware stamp — keep`(insert 侧 `stripRuntimeOwnedFields`,`:736`);update 侧同形于 `:700`(`stripReadonlyFields`,`:682`)。
- `preserveAudit` 豁免:`:751` `if (preserveAudit && isPreservableUnderAudit(name, def)) continue;`。
- 豁免范围:`isPreservableUnderAudit`(`:828`)= `if (AUDIT_TIMELINE_FIELDS.has(name)) return true; return def.system !== true;` —— 所以**未标 `system: true` 的 summary 字段在 `preserveAudit` 下确实会被保留**。新注释就是这么写的("kept by `isPreservableUnderAudit`, since a summary field is not `system: true`"),没有夸大成"preserveAudit 也救不了"。
- `isSystem` 整趟跳过:`engine.ts:5271` `if (!opCtx.context?.isSystem) {` 包住整个 strip 循环。

即:受损的是**既非 `isSystem` 也非 `preserveAudit`** 的普通导入/种子写入 —— 新注释正是这样限定的。

## 无 changeset

零生成物、零行为变化、无任何用户可见 surface(不动键、类型、`.describe()`、导出),本 PR **不发布任何东西**,故不加 changeset,改用 `skip-changeset` 标签。依据:`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` 的 changeset gate 自身把"releases nothing"一类明列为 **PREFERRED** 走标签;AGENTS.md:763 只要求 feature / functional improvement 出 changeset。同形先例:**PR #5964**(`docs(spec): HookEvent 枚举注释不再声称批量写把行级谓词放在 input`,纯 TSDoc 订正)已合并,标签 `skip-changeset`,无 changeset。
